## Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)

source(here("Kalman filtering", "ssm_functions.R"))
dir.create(here("output", "state_space_figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)

q <- function(draws, p) apply(draws, 2, quantile, p)
```

## Load main results

```{r}
results_sa <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "local_level_sa_results.rds"))
ft_main    <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "fat_tails_results.rds"))
```

## Robustness A: drop 2010 (start January 2011)

```{r, cache=TRUE}
sa11 <- results_sa |> filter(date >= ymd("2011-01-01"))
y11  <- sa11$pi_sa

# Stage 1 on the shorter sample
fit11 <- StructTS(ts(y11, start = c(2011, 1), frequency = 12), type = "level")
q11   <- unname(fit11$coef["level"] / fit11$coef["epsilon"])
c(sd_step  = sqrt(unname(fit11$coef["level"])),
  sd_noise = sqrt(unname(fit11$coef["epsilon"])),
  K        = (-q11 + sqrt(q11^2 + 4 * q11)) / 2)

# Fat-tailed model on the shorter sample
ft11 <- run_fat_tails(y11, sig2_eta_start = unname(fit11$coef["epsilon"]),
                           sig2_eps_start = unname(fit11$coef["level"]))
apply(cbind(sd_noise = sqrt(ft11$par[, "sig2_eta"]),
            sd_step  = sqrt(ft11$par[, "sig2_eps"]),
            nu       = ft11$par[, "nu"]),
      2, quantile, c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))

# How much does the fat-tailed trend change?
robust_2011 <- tibble(date = sa11$date, ft_2011 = q(ft11$tau, 0.50)) |>
  left_join(select(ft_main, date, ft_main = tau_med), by = "date")
summary(abs(robust_2011$ft_2011 - robust_2011$ft_main))

saveRDS(robust_2011, here("data", "state_space", "robust_2011_fat_tails.rds"))

robust_2011 |> mutate(diff = abs(ft_2011 - ft_main)) |> arrange(desc(diff)) |> head(5)
```



## Robustness A (continued): UC-SV from 2011

```{r, cache=TRUE}
ucsv_main <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "ucsv_results.rds"))

ucsv11 <- run_ucsv(y11, tau_start = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit11)), gamma = 0.2 / 3)

robust_2011_ucsv <- tibble(
  date           = sa11$date,
  tau_2011       = q(ucsv11$tau, 0.50),
  noise_2011     = q(exp(ucsv11$h / 2), 0.50),
  trend_vol_2011 = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv11$g / 2), 0.50))
) |>
  left_join(select(ucsv_main, date, tau_main = tau_med,
                   noise_main = noise_vol, trend_vol_main = trend_vol), by = "date")
saveRDS(robust_2011_ucsv, here("data", "state_space", "robust_2011_ucsv.rds"))

summary(abs(robust_2011_ucsv$tau_2011 - robust_2011_ucsv$tau_main))
summary(coda::effectiveSize(coda::mcmc(ucsv11$g)))

p_r11 <- robust_2011_ucsv |>
  select(date, noise_2011, noise_main, trend_vol_2011, trend_vol_main) |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  mutate(component = if_else(str_starts(name, "noise"), "Noise volatility", "Trend volatility"),
         sample    = if_else(str_ends(name, "2011"), "from 2011", "from 2010 (main)")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = sample)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "sd, annualized pp", colour = NULL)
p_r11
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "robust_2011_ucsv_volatilities.png"),
       p_r11, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Robustness B: 2015-base sample (2006-2022)

```{r, cache=TRUE}
pi_2015 <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "headline_pi_2015base.rds"))

# Seasonally adjust the 2015-base index with X-13, same as the main series
sa15    <- seasonal::seas(ts(pi_2015$index, start = c(2006, 2), frequency = 12))
y15     <- as.numeric(1200 * diff(log(seasonal::final(sa15))))
dates15 <- seq(ymd("2006-03-01"), ymd("2022-07-01"), by = "month")
stopifnot(length(y15) == length(dates15))

# Stage 1
fit15 <- StructTS(ts(y15, start = c(2006, 3), frequency = 12), type = "level")
q15   <- unname(fit15$coef["level"] / fit15$coef["epsilon"])
c(sd_step  = sqrt(unname(fit15$coef["level"])),
  sd_noise = sqrt(unname(fit15$coef["epsilon"])),
  K        = (-q15 + sqrt(q15^2 + 4 * q15)) / 2)

# Fat-tailed model
ft15 <- run_fat_tails(y15, sig2_eta_start = unname(fit15$coef["epsilon"]),
                           sig2_eps_start = unname(fit15$coef["level"]))
apply(cbind(sd_noise = sqrt(ft15$par[, "sig2_eta"]),
            sd_step  = sqrt(ft15$par[, "sig2_eps"]),
            nu       = ft15$par[, "nu"]),
      2, quantile, c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))

# Compare trends with the main (2023-base) results where they overlap
robust_2015 <- tibble(date        = dates15,
                      stage1_2015 = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit15)),
                      ft_2015     = q(ft15$tau, 0.50)) |>
  left_join(select(results_sa, date, stage1_main = smoothed), by = "date") |>
  left_join(select(ft_main,    date, ft_main     = tau_med),  by = "date")
saveRDS(robust_2015, here("data", "state_space", "robust_2015base.rds"))

robust_2015 |>
  filter(!is.na(ft_main)) |>
  group_by(year = year(date)) |>
  summarise(stage1_gap = mean(abs(stage1_2015 - stage1_main)),
            ft_gap     = mean(abs(ft_2015 - ft_main)))

p_r15 <- robust_2015 |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Annualized inflation (%)", colour = NULL)
p_r15
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "robust_2015base_trends.png"),
       p_r15, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Robustness B (continued): same window, different base year

```{r, cache=TRUE}
win  <- function(d) d >= ymd("2010-03-01") & d <= ymd("2022-07-01")
y15w <- y15[win(dates15)]
y23w <- results_sa$pi_sa[win(results_sa$date)]

fit15w <- StructTS(ts(y15w, start = c(2010, 3), frequency = 12), type = "level")
fit23w <- StructTS(ts(y23w, start = c(2010, 3), frequency = 12), type = "level")
rbind(base2015 = sqrt(fit15w$coef), base2023 = sqrt(fit23w$coef))

base_window <- tibble(date     = results_sa$date[win(results_sa$date)],
                      base2015 = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit15w)),
                      base2023 = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit23w)))
saveRDS(base_window, here("data", "state_space", "robust_base_same_window.rds"))

base_window |>
  group_by(year = year(date)) |>
  summarise(gap = mean(abs(base2015 - base2023)))
```

## Robustness B (continued): UC-SV on 2006-2022 — does trend volatility spike in 2008?

```{r, cache=TRUE}
ucsv15 <- run_ucsv(y15, tau_start = as.numeric(tsSmooth(fit15)), gamma = 0.2 / 3)

ucsv15_results <- tibble(
  date         = dates15,
  tau_med      = q(ucsv15$tau, 0.50),
  noise_vol    = q(exp(ucsv15$h / 2), 0.50),
  trend_vol    = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv15$g / 2), 0.50)),
  trend_vol_lo = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv15$g / 2), 0.05)),
  trend_vol_hi = c(NA, q(exp(ucsv15$g / 2), 0.95))
)
saveRDS(ucsv15_results, here("data", "state_space", "robust_2015base_ucsv.rds"))

summary(coda::effectiveSize(coda::mcmc(ucsv15$g)))

# Trend volatility at a few key dates, with 90% bands
ucsv15_results |>
  filter(date %in% ymd(c("2008-06-01", "2012-01-01", "2016-01-01", "2018-06-01", "2021-06-01"))) |>
  select(date, trend_vol, trend_vol_lo, trend_vol_hi)

vol_long <- bind_rows(
  ucsv15_results |> transmute(date, component = "Trend volatility",
                              med = trend_vol, lo = trend_vol_lo, hi = trend_vol_hi),
  ucsv15_results |> transmute(date, component = "Noise volatility",
                              med = noise_vol, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_)
)

p_ucsv15 <- ggplot(vol_long, aes(date)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = filter(vol_long, !is.na(lo)),
              aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med), na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "sd, annualized pp")
p_ucsv15
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "robust_2015base_ucsv_volatilities.png"),
       p_ucsv15, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)

i08 <- which(dates15 == ymd("2008-06-01")) - 1
i18 <- which(dates15 == ymd("2018-06-01")) - 1
mean(ucsv15$g[, i08] > ucsv15$g[, i18])
```
